paragraphs: Rav Oshaya. He recited before Rava, Berakhot 15b. Is this the Rav Oshaya who spoke to Rav Yehudah? This requires examination, since Rava was born when Rav Yehudah died. Rav Safra told Rav Oshaya, “By Moses! Is what you said really right?” (See above, Rabbi Abba.)
